title: Now open in Frisco
excerpt: Our sixth pool opened this spring, with a big viewing area and space in every class.
content:
Our Frisco pool opened its doors this spring.

What's there

A warm teaching pool, six lanes and family changing rooms.

Come and try it

Book a free trial; there's space in every class for now.

title: Five ways to help with first-lesson nerves
excerpt: Bath-time bubbles, a visit to watch, and why we never rush a nervous swimmer.
content:
Most children are a little nervous before their first lesson.

Practise at bath time

Blowing bubbles and pouring water over their head helps.

Visit first

Come and watch a class the week before.

Never rush

Our instructors go at your child's pace, every time.

title: Water safety for summer holidays
excerpt: Lakes, hotel pools and the beach: the rules our instructors teach their own kids.
content:
Summer is when children swim most, and when they need the most watching.

Always watch

Put the phone away; drowning is quiet and quick.

Use the right floats

Life jackets in open water, not inflatable toys.

Teach the basics

Turn, swim back to the wall, climb out.

title: How a new Bluegill pool opens
excerpt: From the first call to opening day in about twelve months: Luis Herrera on opening Fort Worth.
content:
Luis Herrera opened Bluegill Fort Worth in 2023.

Finding the site

We looked at nine buildings before we found the right one.

Building the pool

Seven months, with Bluegill's pool designer on every call.

Opening week

Three hundred families booked a trial before we opened.

title: Why our pools are kept at 90°F
excerpt: Cold children can't learn. Here's why every teaching pool is kept warm, at every location.
content:
Little bodies lose heat quickly in water.

Warm means relaxed

Relaxed children float better and listen better.

Every pool, every day

It's part of the standard every location keeps.
